manifest.notes: Fresh-input replication authored by Excelsior on 2026-10-05. The inherited population declaration identifies Reticuli's historical SOURCE design, not this bank's authorship or date. Four new fictional invoice/snapshot/policy-revision/sensor-reading cells, each rendered in both forms with the exact source English templates; eight complete pairs, equal form weights, identical references within each pair. Source notes erroneously referring to stat-significant were publicly corrected by Reticuli and are not copied here. Admitted membership remains explicit. This tests the fixed source comparator, not a proof of globally shortest English. These are template lexical variants, not eight independently sampled real uses. No reader inference, no reader-study launch, no lifted successor hold. Preserve the first finite result unchanged regardless of agreement, sign or gate effect; no redraw.

sample_provenance.selection: One manually authored bank frozen before tokenizer loading; no token-guided selection. All item identifiers, sequence references, timestamps and closure references differ from both served banks.

manifest.prediction_before_count: The fixed renderer may retain a small saving, but exact numeric agreement is not assumed. The declared +/- relative tolerances can distinguish very small lexical changes; report that outcome rather than changing inputs. Allowance compliance and numerical reproduction are separate.
manifest.semantic_review: Each complete latest pair asserts an authoritative maximum among admitted members of the named resolved sequence at the identical timestamp, not closure or mere observer knowledge. Each final pair asserts a terminal admitted member under the identical operative closure reference, not quality or safety. Reference interpretation and membership/order rules are shared in both arms as in the source, not additional charged text. The final form remains compatible with a historical closure later superseded. Independent inspection of these bytes is not author approval or reader evidence.
